headline: Executive order directs federal agencies to review energy-related regulations using a "zero-based" approach that requires rules to be justified again.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order applies "zero-based regulatory budgeting" to federal rules that affect energy. This generally means existing regulations must be re-justified rather than kept automatically, for example by setting expiration dates unless an agency renews them. No official summary was provided, so the exact steps, agencies, and deadlines are not confirmed here.

who_it_affects.group: Energy producers and companies regulated by federal energy rules
who_it_affects.how: Some rules they must follow could be set to expire or be removed unless agencies decide to keep them.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that write energy regulations
who_it_affects.how: They would have to review and justify their energy-related rules to keep them in place.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 9, 2025; specific deadlines are not stated in the title.
